title: Documents
source: Read-only via Notion MCP notion-fetch on 2026-11-17 from the live saas and realty CRMs (both carry the merged Documents database; the separate Reports database is retired, decision 0022). Data source ids are not carried and are NOT portable: a deploy creates new ones.

Projects.note: The project keys of the row (decision 0053): the same options as Clients Projects. `hub install --only notion.projects` adds a brand's option where none has its key.

Date.note: date of the document or of the conversation (report)

Type.note: Report marks a conversation report; the Reports view filters on it

Status.note: document lifecycle. Live saas is select, live realty is status (trap 1): both match this entry

Report status.note: report preparation, only for Type = Report; a separate property, not Status

Other participants.note: reports only: outside people not in Clients; never create a CRM contact for a report

Original participants.note: migrated reports only; skipped in a fresh deploy

Original report.note: migrated reports only; skipped in a fresh deploy

Clients.note: optional, one-way; named People in the live saas CRM, Clients in realty: the alias lets one pack match both, no per-instance fork

Deal.note: optional, one-way, not limited to one on this database

Tasks.note: two-way; reverse Tasks.Documents (changes the Tasks schema)

noteVsPack: Status is type status in realty and select in saas (trap 1; the pack creates select). Relation People (saas) vs Clients (realty): alias. Owner has notifications none in realty only. Type options SEO is the owner's.
